name: Metric and Colored Yang Obstructions Agree
statement: For every finite nonempty ample family $H$, $\omega_{\mathrm{met}}(H)=\omega_{\mathrm{ord}}(H)$. Their common value is zero exactly for dismantlable ample families and one exactly for nonpeelable ample families.
proof: The metric Yang obstruction theorem identifies $\omega_{\mathrm{met}}(H)=1$ exactly with nonpeelability. The colored order-sphere obstruction theorem gives the same characterization for $\omega_{\mathrm{ord}}(H)$. Both invariants are binary, so they agree on every ample family; their singleton normalizations also agree.
comments: The values agree, but the two covers retain different local information: the metric cover uses distance-two intervals, while the colored cover retains latent-chart owner data.
